description: This file defines the MockLevelCluster class, a component that mocks a Zigbee cluster related to device level control, including handling commands and attributes such as level and onLevel.

classes.name: MockLevelCluster
classes.description: A mock cluster class for simulating device level control, handling commands and managing level attributes.

methods.name: MockLevelCluster
methods.description: Constructor initializing the mock level cluster with specific EUI-64 and endpoint ID.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Processes incoming commands, notably the move-to-level with on/off command.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the device level and reports the attribute.

methods.name: setOnLevel
methods.description: Sets the on level attribute and reports the change.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Retrieves attribute data based on the attribute info provided.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Updates attribute data based on provided payload and attribute info.
